items.question: What specific mantra repetition must be completed by the one worshipped by gods?
premises: The instruction is addressed to one worshipped by gods.
A hundred thousand repetitions are prescribed.
The practice is situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
items.inference: The revered practitioner must complete a hundred-thousandfold repetition focused on the forehead syllable-mass.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the syllable-mass on the forehead is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O you worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
